content: निःशङ्क {%a.%} Free from fear, careless, secure. .{@-ङ्कम्@} {%ind.%} Fearlessly, easily; निःशङ्कं दीयते लोकैः पश्य भस्मचये पदम्.
.{@-शङ्क@} ({@निःशङ्क@}) {%a.%} free from fear or risk, secure, fearless. ({@निःशङ्कः@}) (in music) a kind of dance. --{%f.%} (निःशङ्का) absence of fear. --{%ind.%} fearlessly, securely, easily.
